_note: Synthetic legitimate postings with emails, employer-paid equipment and optional chat-app lines. Fake companies and example.com subdomains only. None may fail a scam rule.
_t16: Moved to P5 T16 (fix round 6, ruling R6-M1): the scam line "Purchase the laptop from our partner store with your equipment stipend." gives no rule, because a partner store counts as the employer's place only after a sent check.
